notes: Sync now works for tenants where only some products are set up — basic tenant info syncs through whichever product you've consented, instead of failing when Conditional Access Vault isn't activated. And a Sync that 403'd right after you granted consent now self-heals: a token cached before consent finished is no longer reused for the rest of the hour.

The Grant admin consent panel only nags about products that still need action — once a product is consented it drops out of the prompt, and when everything's consented the panel collapses to a quiet confirmation with a Manage consent option for re-granting later.
Tenant actions menu (Edit display name / Remove tenant) rows are aligned.
